import numpy as np

# Data for FY 1953 to FY 1962 (from Table 2 - Monetary Stocks of Gold and Silver)
# Gold: independent variable (X)
# Silver: dependent variable (Y)

years = [1953, 1954, 1955, 1956, 1957, 1958, 1959, 1960, 1961, 1962]
gold = np.array([22462.8, 21927.0, 21677.6, 21799.1, 22622.9, 21356.2, 19704.6, 19322.2, 17550.2, 16435.2])
silver = np.array([3814.3, 3863.1, 3922.3, 3994.5, 4116.6, 4306.0, 4414.1, 4394.5, 4346.5, 4317.4])

print("Data for FY 1953 to FY 1962:")
print("Year | Gold ($M) | Silver ($M)")
for i, year in enumerate(years):
    print(f"{year} | {gold[i]:.1f} | {silver[i]:.1f}")

# Perform linear regression: silver = a + b * gold
# Using numpy polyfit (degree 1 = linear)
coefficients = np.polyfit(gold, silver, 1)
b = coefficients[0]  # slope
a = coefficients[1]  # intercept

print(f"\nLinear regression: Silver = {a:.6f} + {b:.6f} * Gold")

# Calculate R-squared
# First, get predicted values
silver_pred = a + b * gold

# Calculate SS_res (residual sum of squares)
ss_res = np.sum((silver - silver_pred) ** 2)

# Calculate SS_tot (total sum of squares)
silver_mean = np.mean(silver)
ss_tot = np.sum((silver - silver_mean) ** 2)

# R-squared
r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)

print(f"\nR-squared: {r_squared:.10f}")
print(f"R-squared (rounded to 2 decimal places): {round(r_squared, 2)}")

# Also calculate correlation coefficient for verification
correlation = np.corrcoef(gold, silver)[0, 1]
print(f"Correlation coefficient: {correlation:.10f}")
print(f"R-squared from correlation: {correlation**2:.10f}")
EOF

import math

# Data for FY 1953 to FY 1962 (from Table 2 - Monetary Stocks of Gold and Silver)
# Gold: independent variable (X)
# Silver: dependent variable (Y)

years = [1953, 1954, 1955, 1956, 1957, 1958, 1959, 1960, 1961, 1962]
gold = [22462.8, 21927.0, 21677.6, 21799.1, 22622.9, 21356.2, 19704.6, 19322.2, 17550.2, 16435.2]
silver = [3814.3, 3863.1, 3922.3, 3994.5, 4116.6, 4306.0, 4414.1, 4394.5, 4346.5, 4317.4]

n = len(gold)
print("Data for FY 1953 to FY 1962:")
print("Year | Gold ($M) | Silver ($M)")
for i, year in enumerate(years):
    print(f"{year} | {gold[i]:.1f} | {silver[i]:.1f}")

# Calculate means
mean_gold = sum(gold) / n
mean_silver = sum(silver) / n

print(f"\nMean gold: {mean_gold:.4f}")
print(f"Mean silver: {mean_silver:.4f}")

# Calculate slope (b) and intercept (a) using least squares
# b = Σ((x - x̄)(y - ȳ)) / Σ((x - x̄)²)
# a = ȳ - b * x̄

numerator = 0
denominator = 0

for i in range(n):
    numerator += (gold[i] - mean_gold) * (silver[i] - mean_silver)
    denominator += (gold[i] - mean_gold) ** 2

b = numerator / denominator
a = mean_silver - b * mean_gold

print(f"\nLinear regression: Silver = {a:.6f} + {b:.6f} * Gold")

# Calculate R-squared
# First, get predicted values
silver_pred = [a + b * g for g in gold]

# Calculate SS_res (residual sum of squares)
ss_res = sum((silver[i] - silver_pred[i]) ** 2 for i in range(n))

# Calculate SS_tot (total sum of squares)
ss_tot = sum((silver[i] - mean_silver) ** 2 for i in range(n))

# R-squared
r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)

print(f"\nSS_res: {ss_res:.4f}")
print(f"SS_tot: {ss_tot:.4f}")
print(f"\nR-squared: {r_squared:.10f}")
print(f"R-squared (rounded to 2 decimal places): {round(r_squared, 2)}")

# Also calculate correlation coefficient for verification
corr_num = sum((gold[i] - mean_gold) * (silver[i] - mean_silver) for i in range(n))
corr_den = math.sqrt(denominator * ss_tot)
correlation = corr_num / corr_den
print(f"\nCorrelation coefficient: {correlation:.10f}")
print(f"R-squared from correlation: {correlation**2:.10f}")
EOF
